newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures close mixed, S&Ps end up.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures close mixed, S&Ps end up.

text.p: May 15 - U.S. stock index futures closed mixed, with S&Ps settling up, but off record highs. Several traders were unimpressed with June S&Ps' late rally. They said June should have closed closer to its all-time high of 846.50. Volume was average. May options on futures expire on Friday. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750))
